title: Libraries, Presentations and Cue Sheets | LayerCue from Zero, Episode 4
description:
Build a running order from scratch: what a presentation, a library and a cue sheet are, how to read the sidebar, how to make each one, three ways to put a presentation in a cue sheet, renaming and moving, deleting safely with undo, and hiding the sidebar and finding things with Command F.
New here? Start with Episode 1: Meet LayerCue — The Main Window.
Recorded on LayerCue 0.9.12.
Manual: https://layercue.com/docs/library/
The narration is AI-generated and the music is built from GarageBand loops. The event names in the demo are fictional.
